items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: You know when I saw a book on Hitler on Louis’s shelf I said to him, “Pops, how the hell do you read about this monster?”

ctx.x: Dynamite. I mean Louis was so intelligent. He was so well read. You know when I saw a book on Hitler on Louis’s shelf I said to him, “Pops, how the hell do you read about this monster?” He said, “Look, you’ve got to know why you’re hating somebody.” He just felt if they’re going to put it in a library and people are going to talk about it you have to learn it. You have to learn all this. And he had it. That’s the last present I gave him was a book on birds and foliage because Lucille fixed the garden and she…

Well this has really been fascinating just to wrap up, is there anything that you’d like to share with me about, either one of you, about the projects you’re working on? I know you’re on a lot of them.
